events.text:
La hipoxia desencadena programas génicos específicos de cada tejido. En corderos produce pérdida posnatal del fenotipo graso pardo, en adenocarcinoma pulmonar amplifica la transcripción de respuesta a hipoxia mediante SATB2, y en carcinoma escamoso marca endotelio angiogénico mediante STC2. Los modelos y tejidos difieren, por lo que no son directamente comparables.

Síntesis inicial basada en resúmenes recuperados; la verificación detallada sigue en curso.

claims.text: Observe que el ARNm de UCP-1 disminuye en grasa perirrenal de cordero bajo hipoxia gestacional prolongada.
claims.quote: UCP-1 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA lamb perirenal adipose compared to control lambs ( Figure 1(a )).

claims.text: Note que el ARNm de leptina aumenta en corderos LTH-SL pero no en LTH-HA frente a controles.
claims.quote: Leptin mRNA in PRF was significantly higher in LTH-SL lambs but not LTH-HA lamb PRF compared to control lambs ( Figure 1(b )).

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de adiponectina disminuye en grasa perirrenal de corderos LTH-SL frente a controles.
claims.quote: Adiponectin mRNA in perirenal adipose was significantly lower in LTH-SL compared to control ( Figure 2(a )).

claims.text: Observe que el ARNm de PPARγ aumenta en grasa perirrenal de corderos LTH-SL frente a controles.
claims.quote: PPARγ was significantly elevated in LTH-SL PRF compared to control, with LTH-HA PPARγ mRNA levels not different compared to control and LTH-SL ( Figure 3(a )).

claims.text: Considere que la expresión se midió como concentración de ARNm en fg por 50 ng de ARN total.
claims.quote: Messenger RNA concentrations (fg mRNA per 50 ng total RNA) for Uncoupling Protein 1 (UCP1) (a) and leptin (b) in perirenal fat

claims.text: Tenga en cuenta que la hipoxia fue gestacional prolongada moderada con mantenimiento posnatal a gran altitud o a nivel del mar.
claims.quote: 14-day old lambs exposed to long term moderate gestational hypoxia in utero (LTH) then maintained post-birth at either high altitude (HA) or near sea level (SL) through 14 days’ post-birth.

claims.text: Observe que el ARNm de UCP-1 disminuye en grasa perirrenal de cordero bajo hipoxia gestacional prolongada.
claims.quote: UCP-1 mRNA was significantly lower in both LTH-SL and LTH-HA lamb perirenal adipose compared to control lambs ( Figure 1(a )).

claims.text: Note que el ARNm de leptina aumenta en corderos LTH-SL pero no en LTH-HA frente a controles.
claims.quote: Leptin mRNA in PRF was significantly higher in LTH-SL lambs but not LTH-HA lamb PRF compared to control lambs ( Figure 1(b )).

events.reason: source support could not be confirmed

claims.text: Considere que el ARNm de SATB2 se induce marcadamente por hipoxia en lineas LUAD.
claims.quote: RT-qPCR analysis showed that SATB2 mRNA expression was markedly induced by hypoxia across these LUAD cell lines ( Fig. 1A ).

claims.text: Considere que la expresion de ARNm de SATB2 en lineas LUAD se midio por RT-qPCR.
claims.quote: (A) RT-qPCR analysis of SATB2 mRNA expression in indicated LUAD cell lines cultured under normoxia (20% O 2 ) or hypoxia (1% O 2 ) for 24 h.

claims.text: Considere lineas LUAD humanas cultivadas a 20 por ciento de O2 frente a 1 por ciento durante 24 h.
claims.quote: we first examined SATB2 expression in a panel of human LUAD cell lines, including A549, H1299, H1975, NCI-H23, H1650, and Calu-3, cultured under normoxic conditions (20% O₂) or hypoxic conditions (1% O₂) for 24 h.

claims.text: Considere que los niveles de proteina SATB2 aumentaron en celulas LUAD tratadas con hipoxia por western blot.
claims.quote: western blot analysis revealed increased SATB2 protein levels accompanied by HIF-1α stabilization in hypoxia-treated LUAD cells ( Fig. 1B and Supplementary Fig. 1A).

claims.text: Considere que la perdida de HIF-1alfa reduce marcadamente la expresion de SATB2 en normoxia e hipoxia.
claims.quote: Loss of HIF-1α led to a marked reduction in SATB2 expression under both normoxic and hypoxic conditions.

claims.text: Considere que celulas A549 y H1299 expuestas a normoxia o hipoxia por 36 h se analizaron por ChIP-qPCR.
claims.quote: ChIP-qPCR assays in A549 and H1299 cells exposed to normoxia or hypoxia for 36 h

claims.text: Considere que la expresión de SATB2 resulta inducida por hipoxia y regulada por HIF-1α.
claims.quote: We found that SATB2 expression was induced by hypoxia and directly regulated by HIF-1α through promoter binding.

claims.text: Considere HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3 y ALDOA como genes de respuesta a hipoxia enriquecidos.

geneticContext.gene: HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3, and ALDOA

claims.quote: multiple hypoxia-responsive genes, including HIF1A, VEGFA, SLC2A1, PGK1, LOX, LDHA, BNIP3, and ALDOA, displayed similar enrichment patterns.

claims.text: Evalúe el uso de ensayos reporteros de luciferasa y ChIP para estudiar SATB2 en LUAD.
claims.quote: Luciferase reporter and ChIP assays supported SATB2 as a hypoxia-responsive chromatin regulator in LUAD.

claims.text: Considere los análisis transcriptómicos espaciales para extender observaciones a tejidos humanos de LUAD.
claims.quote: In this study, spatial transcriptomic analyses extended our mechanistic observations from cellular and murine models to human LUAD tissues.

claims.text: Considere que nichos malignos asociados a SATB2 muestran activación coordinada de programas transcripcionales de hipoxia.
claims.quote: These findings suggest that SATB2-associated malignant niches are accompanied by coordinated activation of hypoxia-related transcriptional programs within the LUAD microenvironment.

claims.text: Considere que SATB2 es diana transcripcional directa de HIF-1α, pero no de HIF-2α.
claims.quote: Importantly, SATB2 itself is a direct transcriptional target of HIF-1α, but not HIF-2α, establishing a positive regulatory feedback loop that may amplify HIF-1α-dependent transcriptional responses during hypoxic adaptation.

claims.text: Considere SATB2 como regulador epigenético inducible por hipoxia identificado en LUAD.
claims.quote: we identify SATB2 as a previously unrecognized hypoxia-inducible epigenetic regulator in LUAD.

claims.text: Observe que HIF-1α, a diferencia de HIF-2α, interactúa con el promotor de SATB2 y promueve su expresión en hipoxia.

geneticContext.effect: promoting its expression in hypoxic environments

claims.quote: HIF-1α, unlike HIF-2α, directly interacts with the promoter of SATB2, promoting its expression in hypoxic environments.

claims.text: Considere la integración de modelos celulares LUAD, modelos tumorales murinos y transcriptómica espacial con deconvolución para identificar SATB2.
claims.quote: by integrating LUAD cell models, murine tumor models, and spatial transcriptomics with reference-based cell-type deconvolution, we identify SATB2

claims.text: Evalúe que los programas hipóxicos asociados a SATB2 se enriquecen preferentemente en nichos tumorales malignos.

geneticContext.effect: preferentially enriched within malignant tumor niches

claims.quote: Spatial transcriptomic analyses further show that SATB2-associated hypoxic programs are preferentially enriched within malignant tumor niches

claims.text: Considere que la pérdida de SATB2 reduce la acetilación H3K27 y la ocupación de polimerasa II en loci diana de HIF-1.
claims.quote: while SATB2 loss reduces H3K27 acetylation and elongating RNA polymerase II occupancy at HIF-1 target loci
